data.transcript_ur: میرے بیٹے کو رات سے تیز بخار تھا، پھر اچانک جھٹکے آنے لگے، دو منٹ تک رہے۔ چھ سال کا ہے۔
data.translation_en: My son had a high fever since last night, then suddenly started having convulsions, which lasted for two minutes. He is six years old.
missing_info: Did he lose consciousness completely during the episode?
